protocol.loss: 0.5 * sum(active normalized residual squared) / global active rows; value_coef=1
protocol.gradients: raw autograd BEFORE global clipping or Adam; global phase contributions sum to global gradient
protocol.head: value_head.*
protocol.norm_share: norms are not additive; norm mass is NOT a causal update percentage; signed global projection is additive
protocol.baseline: train-only phase x 50 elapsed-phase steps; absent bin falls back to train phase mean
protocol.limitations: Fixed checkpoints, not historical optimizer steps. Correlated agent/time rows in 30 train + 10 heldout all-safe episodes. No repeated conditional outcomes; irreducible variance not identified.
